about.text: Milk flavoured with coffee and usually sugar, sold in small glass bottles and a standard drink at Japanese public baths. In Japan the coffee extract is adjusted to pH 6.5 to 7.0 before the milk is added, to stop it curdling, and the mix is sterilised. In Korea it is made by mixing coffee syrup or extract into milk.
